sources.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather / style-transfer. Edit target: the referenced portrait tower-defense battlefield. Create a final production background for a friendly bright hand-painted chibi fantasy defense game, 9:16 portrait. Keep the top-down battlefield layout, vanishing point, camera and exact main fortress wall position at 68% canvas height. Keep four flat battlement ally stations along that wall and the small centered archer platform at 89% canvas height; these are occupied by separately rendered game characters. Replace the gloomy orange ruined wasteland with clear warm midday sunlight, soft pale blue sky, distant rounded green hills, fresh grass just at the far sides, and a wide empty warm beige battle lane. Remove dead trees, debris piles, sharpened stakes, broken banners, skulls, ruined towers, torches and excessive stone cracks. Clean broad color shapes and rounded cream stone castle, a few restrained teal banners, very subtle surface texture. High readability for bright skill effects and small moving enemy sprites. Upper battle lane must remain open, uncluttered and low contrast; no painted characters, no UI, no text, no icons, no watermark. Preserve wall and platform alignment precisely.

Use case: stylized-concept. A transparent 2D game VFX sprite atlas of tiny GOLDEN ARROW MAGIC glyphs. Exact 4 columns × 8 rows, 32 square equal cells. Each frame is a SMALL COMPLETE symbol centered in its cell with huge clean transparent margins; the symbol itself should occupy only 40 percent of cell width and height. Frames 0-7: eight gold-white bow spark flashes. Frames8-15: eight slim vertical upright complete golden arrow bolts, point at top, tiny tail below. Frames16-23: eight gold-white star hit bursts. Frames24-31: eight faint fading gold spark rings. Smooth progression across each group, consistent scale, hard clean outlined cartoon shape, bright white core, amber outline, compact glow tightly hugging the glyph. No smoke or speckled halo outside symbol. Completely transparent alpha background, no text, labels, grid, borders, watermark or scenery. Every complete arrow, star and ring must be far from all cell edges and must not touch any other frame. Portrait 1024×2048 sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Brand-new production 2D animated VFX atlas for a bright friendly hand-painted fantasy tower-defense game. Golden electric bull magic: muzzle is a compact gold-white spark orb; flight is an upright branching lightning bolt; impact is a burst of jagged gold-white arcs; linger is a fading circular electric spark field. EXACT regular grid of 4 columns by 8 rows, 32 square cells, portrait 1:2 sheet. Reading left to right, top to bottom: frames 0-7 muzzle charge, 8-15 travelling effect, 16-23 impact, 24-31 lingering fade. Each phase has 8 successive smooth animation frames. Every isolated frame is centered inside the CENTRAL 55% of its own cell, with at least 22% FULLY TRANSPARENT PADDING on ALL FOUR SIDES. Keep the COMPLETE silhouette and glow strictly inside each cell; absolutely no cut edges, cropped particles, content across cell borders, or neighboring frame contamination. Bright luminous near-white cores, saturated colored outline, smooth clean bold shapes, compact soft glow. Transparent background with real alpha. No dark smoke, checkerboard, scenery, characters, text, labels, borders, grid lines or watermarks. Four phases are distinct. Maintain consistent scale and pivot throughout each phase; no growing until cut off. Preferred canvas 1024x2048.
